title: spritefx effect
description: A pixel-art visual effect: phases on a tick clock, layers that each map a value field to a ramp. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

cell.description: pixels per cell (default 1; 2 gives chunkier, blobbier smoke)

at.description: the grid's bottom-centre in effect space (default [0, 0])

boundary.description: free (default: open, smoke leaves), wall (no flow through the edges), wrap (toroidal)

at.description: centre in effect px, each axis a parameter over layer u

density.description: density added per tick at the centre (default 0.3); density is capped at 2, 1 maps to the ramp top

heat.description: temperature added per tick (default = density): what buoyancy lifts

velocity.description: px/tick the flow inside the disc is pulled to: [vx, vy] or {speed, angle (deg, 270 = up, default 270)}; absent = no push

during_u.description: [u0, u1] of the layer's progress when the source emits (default [0, 1]); pre-roll ticks count as u = 0

pulse.description: [period, on] ticks: emit only the first `on` ticks of every `period` (separate puffs); in a loop, period should divide the loop

ticks.description: ticks the expansion lasts, weakening linearly (default 4); starts at the layer's tick 0

lobes.description: bulges the first push has (default 6; 0 = a round swell)

buoyancy.description: px/tick² of upward lift per unit temperature (default 0.15)

cooling.description: share of temperature lost per tick (default 0.03)

wind.description: [x, y] px/tick² acceleration on the whole flow, each axis a parameter (default [0, 0])

drag.description: share of velocity lost per tick (default 0.05)

expand.description: divergence per unit density per tick: puffs swell as they drift (default 0)

maccormack.description: MacCormack correction weight for velocity and density advection (default 1; 0 = plain semi-Lagrangian, softer)

diffusion.description: density and temperature diffusion per tick: rounds blobs, melts one-cell wisps (default 0.08)

dissipation.description: density subtracted per tick: erodes the shape from its thin edges (default 0.02)

sponge.description: cells along free top and side edges where smoke erodes faster, so the box never cuts it flat (default 5; 0 = off)

threshold.description: density at or below this is empty (default 0.2)

invert.description: dense smoke maps to the dark end of the ramp (default false)

shade.description: share of the value from a top-lit bevel (default 0.6; 0 = density only)

light.description: degrees toward the light (default 250: up and a little left)

shade_px.description: how far the bevel probe looks, px (default 3)

preroll.description: ticks simulated before the layer's first tick (default 2 x height when looping, else 0)

loop.description: blend the last `crossfade` ticks into the pre-roll so the loop is seamless (default when the layer spans the loop)

crossfade.description: crossfade ticks (default min(10, a third of the loop))

lobes.description: draw the smoke as hand-drawn lobes the simulated flow carries (Saint11's puffs: round, top-lit in three tones toward `light`, bitten into crescents, then dots) instead of the thresholded density

count.description: lobes each source puffs at the start of each on-window (default 3; a range draws per puff)

every.description: ticks between puffs while a source stays on (default 0: one puff per on-window)

spread.description: lobes scatter within this share of the source radius, or [x, y] shares for an oval (default 1)

r.description: lobe radius px over its life (default 4)

size_jitter.description: each lobe's radius varies by up to this share (default 0.2)

erode.description: [bite, dots]: life shares where the crescent bite starts and where it breaks into dots (default [0.3, 0.72])

follow.description: share of the grid's flow a lobe rides (default 1)

drift.description: [x, y] px/tick added to a lobe's motion, each axis a parameter keyed over the lobe's own life (default [0, 0])

value_over_life.description: multiplier on the lobe's tones over its life (default 1)

cut.description: degrees the crescent bite comes from (90 = from below; default opposite `light`), each lobe within ±45

shadow.description: px of a darker step along the cloud's edge away from `light` (default 0 = none)

spacing.description: px a puff keeps between its lobes' centres when the source disc has room (default 0: plain random)

cohesion.description: 0..1: how much a lobe rides the flow at its puff's centre instead of its own, so a puff holds together (default 0)

bite.description: `lobe` (default): each lobe is eaten into its own crescent; `puff`: one bite hollows each puff, leaving a ring of arcs (chimney puffs)

step.description: ticks between lobe moves (default 1; 2 = on twos, all lobes on the same ticks, so thin rims do not strobe); in a loop it should divide the loop

stagger.description: ticks between the births of a puff's lobes, so a puff blooms lobe by lobe instead of popping in (default 0)

swell.description: px/tick a puff's lobes drift apart from its centre (default 0), so a hollowed puff opens into a widening ring

cell.description: px per cell, the grid spacing h (default 1)

at.description: Bottom-centre of the grid, read at u = 0 (default [0, 0])

walls.description: Solid sides (default [left, right, bottom]); particles leaving an open side are removed

damping.description: Share of speed pool water loses per tick, keyed (default 0)

sponge.description: Cells beside each side wall that absorb waves (default 0)

rest_density.description: Particles per cell at rest (default: the fill density)

pool.description: Cells of still water filling the bottom at the start (default 0)

obstacle.description: A solid circle (px), keyed; not drawn

free.description: Ballistic flight (gravity only) until the water reaches the pool's rest surface, then the grid takes it: clean jet arcs

show.description: above: hide the pool below its rest surface (default all)

release.description: px above the rest surface where `free` water joins the grid (default 0.5)

rim_shade.description: value_from rim: [shadow rim, lit rim, core, glint/foam] values (default [0.12, 0.37, 0.62, 0.9])

light.description: value_from rim: degrees toward the light (default 225, upper left)

pulse.description: Water emitted on the first `on` ticks of every `every` draws one value lighter (rim mode): glints that ride the stream

foam.description: value_from rim: liquid within `height` px above the waterline takes the top rim_shade value

spray_value.description: Fixed value of 1 px spray droplets (default: from depth and speed)

xy.description: A fixed [x, y] point (no keys, no ranges): read once
